The [[Imperial Dragon's Tear]] is the end-game [[reward trophy]] obtained from [[Miku]] after completing [[The Final Confrontation]], the last quest in [[Winds of Change]]. Each [[character]] can receive up to three: one from the [[normal mode]] version and two from [[hard mode]]. They cannot be [[trade]]d to other players, but [[Azume]] will exchange them for a [[unique]] [[:category:Imperial Dragon weapons|Imperial Dragon weapon]].

==Collectors==
{{:Azume/Collector}}

== Notes ==
* Imperial Dragon's Tears are the only end-game reward trophies that cannot be [[trade]]d.
